hero.title: Talk to the tower.
hero.subtitle: A bug, an idea, a thermal you can't explain. Write it down. We read everything, and replies come from an actual pilot, usually within forty-eight hours.

noEmail.title: Why no email address
noEmail.body: We don't publish a mail address on the page. The form blocks bots and rate-limits abuse. Same inbox, quieter signal.

ideas.title: Ideas & requests
ideas.body: Change requests, bug reports, half-baked feature ideas: drop them all in the form. Every transmission gets read, and replies typically land within 24 to 48 hours.

form.title: Send a message
form.caption: Every transmission gets read.
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectPlaceholder: A bug, a thermal, an idea…
form.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what's on your mind. Context helps: what you were doing, what you saw, what surprised you.
form.footnote: Replies are handled by an actual pilot. Your message stays between us: never published, never resold.
form.unexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

meta.title: Contact us
meta.description: Get in touch with the We-Fly team. Send us your questions, suggestions or feedback through our secure contact form.
